_doc: Capability overrides for the generated Aruba Central tools. Keys are
operation keys ('METHOD /path' against the normalized full path, e.g.
'destructive'. Use this to reclassify a POST that is effectively read-only
(a diagnostic/query) or a GET with side effects. Add entries with a short
justification rather than editing the generated manifest directly.
Central writes are additionally gated at runtime by HPE_MCP_CENTRAL_WRITES
and every generated write defaults to dry_run=True.
